description: raw-recurrence-mellum-v7 with raw-recurrence-v8's evaluation sizes. Evaluations sized for the owner's budget (2026-10-10: all evaluations ~3% of a stage's wall time, 5% ceiling): the text stages evaluate 8 held documents per cohort (was 16; first and last window each) and the precision gate columns the first 8 held documents (quantization.gate.column_held_documents). Together with the on-device weights fingerprint (a host SHA-256 of 23 GB took ~3.5 of ~4.2 min per evaluation) this targets ~3%; the trainer's logged eval_share shows the real share. History: recipes/HISTORY.md.
